Name: Rehabiah, Son of Eliezer
Summary: Chief of the sons of Eliezer son of Moses, whose sons were very many.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:17: Chief of the sons of Eliezer son of Moses, whose sons were very many.
LifeLesson: The mention of Rehabiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
